author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
## What

A `workflow_dispatch` that passes only a custom `prompt` (no `mode`) had its prompt silently discarded. The `Run Fro Bot` step only consumed `inputs.prompt` when `inputs.mode == 'review'`, and `mode` defaults to `autoheal` — so a bare-prompt dispatch fell through to the autoheal prompt and ran the wrong task.

This surfaced when a cross-repo goal dispatch (which sends only the universal `prompt` input, since not every repo declares a `mode`) triggered an autoheal run here instead of the requested task.

## Fix

Let a non-empty `inputs.prompt` win first for any `workflow_dispatch`, before the mode-based selection:

```diff
-  (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'review' && inputs.prompt)
+  (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.prompt)
```

This matches how the sibling repos wire prompt selection (`inputs.prompt` first, mode/schedule prompts as fallbacks). Behavior when no prompt is supplied is unchanged: maintenance/autoheal still fire by mode, and the separate review-mode input validation step is untouched.

## Verification

- `actionlint` clean on the changed workflow.
- The change is a single clause reorder; the maintenance, autoheal, schedule, and pull_request fallbacks all still apply when `inputs.prompt` is empty.
title: fix(fro-bot): honor a bare workflow_dispatch prompt regardless of mode
